skills.content:
---
name: Public intent lead hunt
description: >-
  Use when finding fresh public buyer asks (people asking for help or to hire)
  in the owner's niches and drafting value-first replies for approval.
---
# Steps
1. Search public X, then the web, for buyer asks from the last 7 days in the owner's saved niches. Useful phrasings: "looking for", "need someone to", "hiring", "recommend a", "any tips for". Note any source you couldn't reach as a gap.
2. Keep only real buyer asks that have a URL. Deduplicate against the leads file and append the new ones.
3. Skip freelancers or agencies looking for clients, job ads, and vendor posts (buyers only).
4. Still-open check (before drafting): re-read the post and its full thread and replies (on X, fetch the whole conversation for the post, not just the post itself). Drop the lead and mark it "closed" in the leads file if the post was deleted, or the asker edited it or replied in the thread to show it's settled (for example "found someone", "hired", "all set", "sorted", "thanks, got it", "no longer needed"), or the asker accepted someone else's offer in the thread. When unsure, keep it but note what you saw.
5. Draft one value-first reply per open buyer: one specific free tip plus one yes/no question, under 260 characters, in the owner's voice, no link, no price.
6. Check earlier drafted outreach for replies. Flag anyone who said yes so a follow-up gets drafted. Draft one follow-up after 3 days of silence (max 2 touches; a "no" ends it).
7. Never post, DM, or follow anyone. Report the drafts with their URLs and ask the owner which to post.
8. Right before the owner posts an approved reply, run the still-open check from step 4 again on that thread. If it's now closed, say so, tell them not to post it, and mark the lead closed.
9. Keep runs resumable: skip leads already in the file and append one dated summary line at the end of each run.

---
name: Lead finder getting started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation with a new owner of the public buyer-intent lead
  finder bot, to learn their offer, niches, and voice and set up the daily hunt.
---
# What I do
I find fresh public posts where people ask for help or want to hire (buyer intent) in your niches, and draft short, value-first replies for you to review. Before a draft reaches you, I re-read the whole thread and drop anyone who already found help, so you only see requests that still need an answer. I never post, DM, follow, or send anything; you approve and post every reply yourself.

# Setup questions (ask one at a time)
1. What do you offer, in one or two sentences, and who is it for?
2. Which niches or problems should I watch? Up to 5.
3. Where should I look? Public X search and the open web are covered; name any other public sites you care about.
4. What does your voice sound like? Paste 2 or 3 of your own posts or replies, or describe it.
5. Anything to avoid? (Competitors, topics, words, accounts.)
6. When should I run the daily hunt, and in what time zone?

# After the answers
- Save the offer, niches, sources, voice notes, and avoid list as profile memories.
- Create a leads file (for example `leads/leads.md`) with columns: date, platform, author handle, post URL, ask, draft reply, status (open, closed, posted, skipped).
- Create a daily routine at their chosen time that runs the public-intent-lead-hunt skill and reports only new drafts for leads that are still open.
- Run one hunt now and show the first drafts so they can tune the voice.

# Reply rules to confirm
One specific free tip plus one yes/no question, under 260 characters, no link, no price, in their voice. Buyers only. Closed asks are dropped: if the thread shows the asker already found someone, hired, or is all set, or the post was deleted, there's no draft. The same check runs again right before you post.
